record.title: LED Road Luminaires - Photometric, Electrical and Environmental Performance
record.description:
Specifies photometric, electrical, thermal, ingress-related, and marking requirements for LED road luminaires used on public and private roads, access ways, and comparable outdoor lighting installations.

Applies to LED luminaires with integral drivers intended for fixed outdoor installation; excludes decorative luminaires and portable work lights.

Key requirements: Declared luminous performance shall be supported by photometric measurements.; Electrical input and protective measures shall meet the specified limits.; Thermal design shall maintain component temperatures within declared limits.; Enclosure and environmental protection shall match the declared installation condition.

Testing requirements: Photometric test and luminous flux verification.; Electrical safety and power-factor related checks where specified.; Thermal endurance and temperature measurement.; Environmental enclosure verification for the declared protection level.

Documentation required: Luminaire technical data sheet.; LED module and driver identification.; Photometric file or equivalent laboratory output.; Environmental and electrical test reports.

Marking requirements: Manufacturer identification.; Model/type designation.; Rated electrical data.; Declared outdoor/environmental protection information and batch traceability.
record.certification_applicability: Certification applicable where the relevant product control order adopts this standard; otherwise conformity may be demonstrated through supplier declaration and test evidence.
